Let nothing escape this castle.''"<br />"''Yes, mistress.|Asajj Ventress and the droid commander|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
During the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], this '''[[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]]''' had been assigned to take out the remaining Clone Troopers by Asajj Ventress as well as seal the main gate and portals to ensure no one escaped from the castle. The droid complied with the order, but was destroyed by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] after he shot the droid with his [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blaster]]. After shooting the droid, Ventress snatched the gun out of Rex's hand.
